top_critical_findings: P0-1: No point-in-time universe exists anywhere in the codebase; every backtest and factor-IC test runs on today's listed 500-symbol universe projected backward to 2020, with zero ability to include historically delisted/suspended names -- severe, structural survivorship bias affecting every performance figure in every report.

P0-2: scripts/build_portfolio_stack.py (the production portfolio-construction and risk-reporting script) reads data/processed/stock_features.parquet directly, which this repo's own DATA_BASELINE.md documents as still containing the raw/adjusted-close corruption for an uncatalogued subset of symbols -- the fixed data/full_history_v2 dataset has not been merged in or repointed to.

P0-3: Independent Phase D recomputation of the committed data/output/portfolio_risk_report.json, using the exact documented method, the same weights, the same source file, and the report's own stated date cutoff, could not reproduce annual_return, annual_volatility, sharpe_ratio, or max_drawdown -- nor even the reported row count (1317 vs. 1621). Weight-derived metrics (max_weight, effective_n, herfindahl_index) reproduced exactly, isolating the gap to the mutable historical return window with no snapshot/hash recorded alongside the output.

P0-4: src/screening/final_watchlist.py's relative_strength_score still merges in alpha_rs_score, the exact v1-shadow rs_score component that SCORE_FORENSIC_REPORT.md identified as flipping from +0.0141 to -0.1060 IC in 2026 and calls a primary driver of a real -59.7% backtest fold. The sibling leak (momentum_score) was already fixed in this same session (commits 517a3d0/327b8d4); the same class of bug in rs_score was not caught and remains live in the composite that reaches Client Ready/Trading Watchlist tiers.

Confirmed strength, for balance: the core portfolio-risk mathematics (w^T Sigma w, marginal/component/percentage risk contribution) is correct and independently confirmed robust to symbol-order mismatches via a direct reversed-order test -- ruling out the single most severe common bug class the audit brief warns about.
recommended_next_phase: Phase 1 of the remediation roadmap (data and mathematical correctness): repoint the production portfolio pipeline off the stale dataset (P0-2), remove the confirmed-harmful alpha_rs_score component from final_watchlist (P0-4), add data-lineage hashing so outputs become reproducible (P0-3), and begin the point-in-time universe effort (P0-1). Shadow/paper-trading mode (already running via alpha_score_shadow_v1) may continue in parallel since it commits no capital. Do not proceed to a real-capital pilot until P0-1 through P0-4 are resolved and Phase D validation is re-run and passes.
